verified.kill_fact: FORWARD is NOT the statistically significant Phase 3 - it is an open-label US/EU generalizability bridge, and that bridge is the reason the BLA slipped a full year. The stat-sig pivotal was the 2024 Bangladesh/Philippines Phase 3 (ANX005 30mg/kg, 2.4x GBS-DS improvement at Wk8, p=0.0058; the 75mg/kg arm MISSED). Annexon guided a BLA off that data for 2025; FDA instead required a "generalizability package," pushing submission to Q4-2026 with FORWARD (early data = first 10 patients, open-label) as the supporting set. So the BLA is not a mechanical filing off a clean pivotal - it rests on an FDA-negotiated bridge from a non-Western population that has already caused one 12-month slip, and the same agency posture can slip it again past Q4. Second correction: net cash is ~$159M, not $175M - $209.2M cash/ST investments at 6/30/26 LESS $50M already DRAWN on the $200M Oxford facility; that is senior secured debt sitting ahead of the common, so "no preferred, clean waterfall" is right in kind but overstated ~10% and omits the drawn tranche. What SURVIVES intact: both events are real, company-guided, dated and fully forward (Month-15 ARCHER II primary "on track for Q4 2026," Month-24 dual primary ADDED while retaining Month-15, completion Q3-2027; BLA "expected in Q4 2026"; EU MAA submitted 2026-01-08 and confirmed still under review at the 8/12 Q2 release). EV recomputes to ~$639M (163.8M shares x $4.87 = $798M cap, less $209M cash, plus $50M debt), close enough to the line's $623M that the "ARCHER II carried at zero" framing holds. Net: thesis stands, two load-bearing facts wrong, and the BLA's regulatory certainty is materially lower than "off a statistically significant Phase 3" implies - trim 7 to 6.
